name: Yauco (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Horizontal bicolour of black and gold charged at the centre with the municipal coat of arms.
history: Yauco is a town and municipality in southern Puerto Rico, where the Intentona de Yauco of 1897 first raised the Puerto Rican flag on the island; Flags of the World records an earlier flag quartered in black and yellow.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown
